headline: Iran attacks cripple 17% of Qatar's LNG capacity for up to five years, severely impacting global energy markets.
summary: Escalating conflict in the Middle East has resulted in the destruction of a significant portion of Qatar's liquefied natural gas production, causing a projected five-year disruption. This substantial loss will critically elevate global energy prices, destabilize supply chains, and indirectly raise operational costs for energy-intensive sectors like AI infrastructure and semiconductor manufacturing worldwide.
